scripts.build: cd portfolio && (npm ci --include=dev || npm install --include=dev) && npx vite build --base=/portfolio/ && cd .. && echo 'Build completed successfully'
scripts.dev:
echo "
  Local:   http://localhost:3000
  CV:      http://localhost:3000/
  Portfolio: http://localhost:3000/portfolio/
" && npx --yes serve . -l tcp://0.0.0.0:3000 -c serve.json --no-port-switching
scripts.frontend:
echo "
  Local:   http://localhost:3000
  CV:      http://localhost:3000/
  Portfolio: http://localhost:3000/portfolio/
" && npx --yes serve . -l tcp://0.0.0.0:3000 -c serve.json --no-port-switching
